rules: Each subsection starts with [Information Required] followed by what it must contain; replace it with the real content.
Each main section starts with an AUTHORING INSTRUCTIONS line; it is guidance for the writer, to be removed from the final document.
Other bracketed values in tables, for example [To be designated], [Per sponsor SOP], [Pending], [Date], [As applicable], [Time], [Section 10], are completed or removed by the author.

writingStandards.rule: Use a Vancouver-style numbered bibliography, in first-citation order.
Insert verified sources only (verified DOI or URL).
Repeated citations retain their original number.
Citation superscripts (numeric) must be distinct from alphabetic table footnotes.
Table footnotes use real alphabetic superscripts; replace the example markers.
All procedures in section 7 reconcile with Table 1 (Schedule of Activities).
Objectives, endpoints, estimands and analyses are aligned (section 3 with section 10).
Statistical methods are aligned to ICH E9 and E9(R1).
Inclusion criteria: numbered, objective, verifiable. Exclusion criteria: numbered, non-overlapping.
The Table of Contents is generated automatically; update all fields after editing.
Generate the list of tables, figures and appendices from captions and appendix headings, and update it after final pagination.
Include only applicable appendices; ensure references in the main text resolve.
Apply region-specific law and sponsor SOP for ethics and regulatory content.
Investigator agreement, ethics approval and sponsor approvals are documented as required by applicable rules and SOPs.
